subject: Acme Corp Renewal & Expansion Recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 14:00:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Renewal & Expansion discussion — next steps

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and the suggested next steps so we stay aligned for the renewal conversation. High level: Acme is now at ~120M tokens/month across generation + embeddings, with a projected 30-40% growth next quarter as you onboard the RAG ingestion pipeline.

Key pain points we heard:
- Latency spikes during peak batch embedding windows (2x above SLA)
- Cost variability from repeated retries and suboptimal batching
- Need for tighter network controls for PII-heavy ingestion (VPC requirement)

Goals you shared:
- Stable 99th percentile latency under 350ms for interactive calls
- Predictable monthly spend for budgeting (reserved pricing)
- Support for high-throughput batch embeddings and RAG indexing jobs

Proposed upsell path:
1) Move to Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) to stabilize latency and unit economics
2) Add Redwood Optimize for batching + quantization recommendations to reduce per-token cost
3) SRE onboarding + a security review for VPC/private deployment to meet your compliance needs

Timeline we discussed:
- Internal budgeting/approval: Aug (you mentioned this week)
- Procurement/contracting: mid-Aug to early Sep
- Target renewal & committed start of Dedicated: by 2026-09-30

Next steps / action items:
- I attached the Q2 usage export and an initial pricing sketch for Dedicated (Acme_Q2_usage_report.csv; proposed_dedicated_pricing_v1.pdf) — Marissa (Owner) — today
- Schedule a technical deep-dive/demo for the RAG / embeddings flow with our solutions engineer (Vivek) — Samantha to confirm availability
- Provide SOC 2 / security checklist for procurement — Marissa to share

If that looks right, I’ll send a mutual action plan doc and lock in a follow-up demo time.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment stubs:
- Acme_Q2_usage_report.csv (csv)
- proposed_dedicated_pricing_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@acmecorp.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Renewal & Expansion discussion — next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap — this matches our notes. A few clarifications and updates from the Acme side:

- Budget: Execs approved the expansion budget this morning; procurement will need an updated SOW and SOC 2 evidence to start contract review.
- Timeline: Procurement expects to kick off formal review the week of Aug 16; legal aims to have a term sheet back by early Sep.
- Technical: We do want a focused demo on the embeddings batching behavior and an example of the RAG ingestion flow. Carlos (cc’d) will own the technical evaluation from our side.

Would you be able to share the SOC 2 summary and any audited security docs? Also can you confirm whether Dedicated supports in-flight KV cache warmup across our nodes (we currently see cold-start latency on the first heavy job of the day).

I’m available for the demo week of Aug 9–13 in the mornings PT.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Director of AI Platforms | Acme Corp
samantha.lee@acmecorp.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Renewal & Expansion discussion — next steps

Thanks Samantha — great to hear on the budget front. Short answers: yes, Dedicated supports KV cache warmup strategies and we have options for progressive cache warmup + prefetching to mitigate cold-starts; Vivek will demo this in the technical session. I’ll also pull together the SOC 2 summary and linkage to our compliance pack.

Proposed mutual action plan (I’ll send a doc version with dates):
- Today (Aug 5): Marissa shared usage + pricing sketch (done)
- Aug 6: Marissa to share SOC 2 summary + compliance links (Owner: Marissa)
- Aug 9–13: Technical deep-dive + RAG/embeddings demo (Owner: Vivek; Confirmed window: morning PT — Vivek, any availability?)
- Week of Aug 16: Procurement starts formal review (Acme)
- Early Sep: Legal/contract term sheet returned (Acme)
- By 2026-09-30: Commit to Dedicated capacity and finalize order

Action owners:
- Marissa: SOC2 docs, mutual_action_plan_ACME.docx, updated pricing (by Aug 6)
- Vivek: Demo + technical runbook (schedule Aug 9–13 mornings PT)
- Carlos / Procurement: kickoff procurement week of Aug 16

Would you like me to schedule the demo for Aug 11 at 10:00 AM PT? I’ll include Vivek and Rishi in the invite and attach the mutual action plan document.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this across the line.

—Marissa
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment stubs:
- mutual_action_plan_ACME.docx (docx)
